WITH region_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    d.A3 as region,
    COUNT(c.client_id) as client_count
  FROM client c
  JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY d.A3
),
total_clients AS (
  SELECT SUM(client_count) as total FROM region_counts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    rc.region,
    rc.client_count,
    CAST(rc.client_count AS REAL) / tc.total as share
  FROM region_counts rc
  CROSS JOIN total_clients tc
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg FROM shares
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    s.region,
    s.client_count,
    s.share,
    a.avg
  FROM shares s
  CROSS JOIN avg_share a
  WHERE s.share > a.avg
)
SELECT 
  SUM(client_count) as total_clients,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(share - avg) as average_distance_above
FROM filtered
